run_gemini_vision_baseline: run the gemini-pro-vision baseline on an EQA dataset using video frames as visual context
ask_question_with_frames: ask a question to Gemini Pro Vision by providing frame image paths and a question string
parse_gemini_output: parse the Gemini API output string to extract the answer after the A: prefix
run_dry_run_baseline: run a dry run of the gemini-pro-vision baseline processing only the first 5 questions
resume_baseline_results: resume the gemini-pro-vision baseline from existing results skipping already completed question IDs
